guitar.notes: Accurate: McCready known for Strat, Gossard for Les Paul/various.

tone.target: aggressive dry grunge crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.profile: aggressive dry grunge crunch with upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A tight signal chain using compression and a classic Marshall-style preamp (UK 45) for aggressive grunge crunch, paired with a punchy 4x12 cabinet and minimal ambience.

blocks.purpose: Cleaning up the aggressive grunge tone and tight palm-muted rhythm playing.
Providing compressed punch and enhancing the attack for tight palm-muting.
Adding the required slight fuzz edge and aggressive crunch without excessive distortion.
blocks.gap: The RAT-style is chosen for its mid-focused, gritty bite, fitting the grunge aesthetic better than pure Distortion or Fuzz.

blocks.purpose: Simulating the classic Marshall/Plexi gain and British voicing required for grunge rock.
Providing the specified 4x12 cabinet voicing and solid British tone foundation.
Sculpting the upper-mid bite and ensuring a tight, focused crunch tone.
Adding the required dry room ambience without muddying the aggressive tone.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism by swapping the generic IR for a specific, punchy 4x12 that matches grunge/grunge-adjacent tones.

proposals.recommendedAsset: Punchy 4x12 (e.g., Ampeg or Celestion Greenback style)
proposals.reason: Enhance the punch and grit of the grunge tone.
